basic_details.job_title: NADA Executive Assistant Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The National Anti Doping Agency (NADA), New Delhi, an autonomous body of the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Government of India, will fill 1 post of Executive Assistant (Level 7, Rs. 44,900–1,42,400) by composite method (deputation including short term contract)/absorption. Only officers of Central/State/UT Governments, PSUs, Autonomous/Statutory Bodies, Universities and Recognized Research Institutes may apply. Applications in the prescribed format go through proper channel to the Director General, NADA, within 60 days from the date of issue of the advertisement in

qualification.details: Applications are invited from Indian Citizens who are officers of the Central/States/UTs Government, PSUs, Autonomous/Statutory Bodies, Universities or Recognized Research Institutes, who: | (a)(i) hold an analogous post on regular basis, or (ii) have 05 years regular service in the post in Level 6 of the Pay Matrix; and (b)(i) are Graduates in Commerce discipline from a recognized university/college/institution; and (b)(ii) have 05 years of relevant experience in Government Institutions. | A departmental candidate in the feeder grade is also eligible to be considered along with the outsiders; if selected, the appointment is deemed to have been made by promotion. Candidates should check the detailed eligibility and qualification criteria for the post in the official notification on the NADA website. | The candidate should be below 56 years of age as on the closing date of the application. The Recruitment Rules add that the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of the receipt of applications. No age relaxation is mentioned in the notice. | Scale of pay: Level 07 in the Pay Matrix, Rs 44,900–1,42,400/-. The terms of deputation, including pay and allowances, are governed by Department of Personnel & Training Office Memorandum No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010 and other orders/guidelines issued from time to time. Method of recruitment: Deputation (including short term contract)/Absorption/Re-employment (for short term contract). The period of deputation shall be 5 years. The lending department may relieve an officer for a lesser period as per its own policy/Rules, which should not be less than three years in any case. The period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or some other organisation/department of the Central Government, shall not ordinarily exceed 5 years. Period of probation: two years for absorption.

important_instructions: Incomplete applications shall not be entertained. Candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. NADA reserves the right not to fill up all or any of the vacancies or to withdraw the circular at any time without assigning any reasons. The number of posts is subject to variation dependent on workload. The circular has been sent to all Ministries/Departments of the Government of India and all State Governments and Union Territory Administrations for wide publicity in their offices.

content_sections.heading: About NADA Executive Assistant
content_sections.text: The National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) is an autonomous body of the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Government of India, with its office at Hall No. 103-104, First Floor, Jawahar Lal Nehru Stadium, New Delhi - 110003. According to the circular, NADA is responsible for promoting, coordinating and monitoring the doping control programme in sports in all its forms across the country. The Executive Assistant post is one of the administrative posts in NADA, and the vacancy circular dated 23 November 2026 is signed by Ajeet Singh, Accounts-cum-Administrative Officer (AAO), NADA.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be completed in the prescribed format and sent through proper channel. The circular says the prescribed qualification, eligibility criteria and other recruitment details may be downloaded from the official NADA website, www.nadaindia.yas.gov.in . The application form is not attached to this circular. The circular prints two different postal addresses, so candidates should confirm the correct address with NADA (Tele: 011-24368274) before dispatching the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian Citizens who are officers of the Central/States/UTs Government, PSUs, Autonomous/Statutory Bodies, Universities or Recognized Research Institutes, who: (a)(i) hold an analogous post on regular basis, or (ii) have 05 years regular service in the post in Level 6 of the Pay Matrix; and (b)(i) are Graduates in Commerce discipline from a recognized university/college/institution; and (b)(ii) have 05 years of relevant experience in Government Institutions. A departmental candidate in the feeder grade is also eligible to be considered along with the outsiders; if selected, the appointment is deemed to have been made by promotion. Candidates should check the detailed eligibility and qualification criteria for the post in the official notification on the NADA website. The candidate should be below 56 years of age as on the closing date of the application. The Recruitment Rules add that the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of the receipt of applications. No age relaxation is mentioned in the notice. Scale of pay: Level 07 in the Pay Matrix, Rs 44,900–1,42,400/-. The terms of deputation, including pay and allowances, are governed by Department of Personnel & Training Office Memorandum No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010 and other orders/guidelines issued from time to time. Method of recruitment: Deputation (including short term contract)/Absorption/Re-employment (for short term contract). The period of deputation shall be 5 years. The lending department may relieve an officer for a lesser period as per its own policy/Rules, which should not be less than three years in any case. The period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or some other organisation/department of the Central Government, shall not ordinarily exceed 5 years. Period of probation: two years for absorption.

rows.pay: Level 7 (Rs. 44,900–1,42,400), as per 7th CPC Pay Matrix

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice, to be sent along with the application: Attested copy of the application in the prescribed proforma Cadre Clearance Certificate from the Controlling Authority Statement giving details of Major/Minor penalties imposed upon the officer, if any, during the last ten (10) years Vigilance Clearance/Integrity Certificate Photocopies of the ACRs/APARs for the last five (5) years, duly attested on each page by an officer not below the level of Under Secretary or equivalent While forwarding the application, the cadre controlling authority may also verify and certify that the particulars furnished by the applicant are correct

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications shall not be entertained. Candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. NADA reserves the right not to fill up all or any of the vacancies or to withdraw the circular at any time without assigning any reasons. The number of posts is subject to variation dependent on workload. The circular has been sent to all Ministries/Departments of the Government of India and all State Governments and Union Territory Administrations for wide publicity in their offices.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NADA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Executive Assistant, and the Recruitment Rules say the number is subject to variation dependent on workload.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NADA Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 60 days from the date of issue of the advertisement in the Employment News/Rozgar Samachar; late applications shall not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for NADA Executive Assistant?
faq.answer: The officer must be a Graduate in Commerce discipline from a recognized university/college/institution with 05 years of relevant experience in Government Institutions, and must hold an analogous post on regular basis or have 05 years regular service in Level 6.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NADA Executive Assistant?
faq.answer: The candidate should be below 56 years of age as on the closing date of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of NADA Executive Assistant?
faq.answer: The post carries Level 7 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (Rs. 44,900–1,42,400), with deputation pay and allowances governed by DoPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for NADA Executive Assistant?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format through proper channel to the Director General, NADA, in a cover superscribed "Application for the position of Executive Assistant", with the cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, penalty statement and attested ACRs/APARs.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the deputation period at NADA?
faq.answer: The period of deputation is 5 years; the lending department may relieve an officer for a lesser period, but not less than three years in any case.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a probation period for the NADA Executive Assistant post?
faq.answer: Yes, the Recruitment Rules prescribe a probation period of two years for absorption.

faq.question: Q9. Can a candidate withdraw the application after applying?
faq.answer: No, candidates who apply for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.
